'''Gimmellian Stealth Devices''' were stealth technology with which [[Tallanx-class stealth fighter|''Tallanx''-class stealth fighters]] were equipped. The Devices interfered with other ships' passive sensors, but required that all power that would otherwise be directed to weapons or shields be used by the device.<ref name="Strongholds" />
